date: Nov 27, 2026 · Week 3 / Day 5 · Upward communication and influence

cards.title: Show the delta
cards.question: Yesterday PCIe margin was at risk; today two corners pass but the hot corner is untested. Give a director a 20-second update.
cards.selfCheck: State what changed, what remains exposed and whether your recommendation changes. Give the next evidence checkpoint, not a blanket green status.
cards.prompt: Coach my 20-second PCIe update. Challenge any claim that exceeds the evidence.

cards.title: Get a real yes
cards.question: Package and board teams agree to investigate a PDN resonance but neither commits resources. How do you turn support into action?
cards.selfCheck: Agree on a shared system outcome, named owners, deliverables and dates. Confirm capacity with each lead and escalate only unresolved commitments.
cards.prompt: Role-play both team leads. Help me negotiate a joint PDN investigation with explicit commitments.

cards.title: Own the correction
cards.question: New fixture characterization undermines your earlier EM/TDR root-cause claim. How do you update leadership?
cards.selfCheck: Correct the earlier claim explicitly and distinguish reliable observations from revised hypotheses. Explain the decision impact and next discriminating test.
cards.prompt: Play a skeptical director. Critique my correction for accountability, confidence and decision relevance.

cards.title: Ask for a reusable fix
cards.question: Repeated crosstalk reviews stall waiting for the same extraction specialist. What investment would you propose to management?
cards.selfCheck: Quantify queue delay and release exposure, then propose a bounded template or cross-training pilot. Define an owner and a measurable cycle-time outcome.
cards.prompt: Help me pitch a two-week extraction bottleneck pilot with baseline, cost and success metric.

cards.title: Turn trust into action
cards.question: A release gate faces marginal PCIe performance and an unresolved PDN waiver. Leadership offers one extra lab shift. Make a 45-second recommendation.
cards.selfCheck: Lead with system risk, allocate the shift by decision value and state the evidence needed for signoff. Secure an owner, decision authority and checkpoint; retain any unmet gate.
cards.prompt: Role-play a VP and validation lead. Score my brief on Weeks 1–3: early risk, tradeoff, uncertainty, influence and explicit commitments.
